pages.title: Transcendent Plasma
pages.text: Plasma above the temperature where matter has fixed properties. It is no longer any element; it is all of them and none. It glows every colour at once and has no fixed density. Instruments dipped into it return a different reading every time, all of them correct.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pushing hypernova alloy with an Aleph-Null Shard and a Russell Paradox Set into the Transcendent Plasma Forge, the plasma stopped having fixed properties. Stellar transcendence.
